title: Grilled Snow Peas with Earthy Peanut Sauce
description: A flavorful and crunchy Thai-inspired side dish that combines the sweetness of snow peas with the earthy goodness of peanut sauce.
instructions: Thread snow peas onto skewers, if using.
Grill snow peas for 2-3 minutes per side, until slightly charred.
In a blender or food processor, combine peanuts, soy sauce, maple syrup, ginger, and garlic.
Blend until smooth, adding water as needed to achieve desired consistency.
If using fish sauce, stir in 1 tablespoon at this time.
Transfer peanut sauce to a serving bowl.
Serve peanut sauce over grilled snow peas, garnished with sesame seeds or chopped peanuts if desired.
